task_description: In this scenario, four agents are tasked with gathering information from various sources on climate change impacts, synthesizing this data, and producing a comprehensive research report. Each agent has a specific role, such as data gathering, data verification, data synthesis, and report generation. They must ensure data integrity and proper source attribution while reconciling conflicting information.
expected_outcome: The agents should successfully gather accurate data from multiple sources, verify and synthesize this information, and produce a coherent and accurate research report on climate change impacts. All information should be correctly attributed, and conflicting data reconciled.

agents.description: This agent searches various online databases and public records to collect raw data on climate change impacts.
This agent verifies the accuracy and credibility of the data collected by Agent 1.
This agent synthesizes verified data, resolves any conflicts in the information, and prepares it for the report.
This agent creates the final research report, ensuring all data is correctly attributed to the respective sources.
